profile: Masco designs, manufactures, and distributes branded home improvement and building products. Its plumbing products include faucets, showerheads, bathing units, plumbing components, water filtration systems, spas, exercise pools, and saunas. Its decorative architectural products include BEHR paints. Customers include retailers, wholesalers, distributors, plumbers, contractors, remodelers, builders, consumers, and specialty spa and sauna dealers.
